verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's single-binary self-hosting model and simple local install (curl/Docker) let a developer spin up an isolated instance to test with sample data separate from production, and Meilisearch Cloud offers a 14-day free trial. However, there is no explicit 'sandbox' or staging-environment feature, no documented way to clone/mirror production data safely, and no AI-native tooling specifically for sandbox testing. missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/staging mode, data-masking or safe-copy tooling for production data, and explicit AI-native sandbox workflow documentation.
